meta.task: FACT-GATHERING ONLY: every existing statement of what the GSE-adaptation coordinates are meant to mean, quoted with exact locations. No definition is proposed. No source is judged right. 'contradictions' quote both sides without a verdict.
meta.path_convention: Paths are relative to the worktree unless they start with '/'. 'file:N' and 'file:N-M' are 1-based line numbers from whole-file Read output. Inside a quote, ' / ' marks a source line break and an ellipsis marks omitted text; everything else is verbatim.
meta.also_noted: NUMBER (a scale operation, not a coordinate) has its own top-level section, and the relations of HIER_PLUS/HIER_MINUS to NUMBER and INTENSITY are collected in hier_number_intensity_relations.

layout_of_this_file.cross_cutting_basis_facts: basis, state and fill-table facts that apply to every coordinate
layout_of_this_file.inventories_of_gse_adaptation_coordinate: which coordinates five sources call GSE additions
layout_of_this_file.founder_record_index: every founder-record entry that touches an in-scope coordinate or NUMBER, with speaker tag
layout_of_this_file.coordinates: one entry per in-scope coordinate: statements, nearest NSM primes named by sources, scale or numeric semantics, founder records, contradiction ids, absences. HIER_PLUS and HIER_MINUS each begin with the statements they share (marked shared_with).
layout_of_this_file.hier_number_intensity_relations: every statement relating HIER_PLUS/HIER_MINUS, NUMBER and INTENSITY
layout_of_this_file.contradictions: C01-C27, both sides quoted, no verdict

meta.reading_method: Files were read with the Read tool in whole-file consecutive chunks unless marked partial. No grep, rg, head, tail, sed, awk, cut, wc or jq and no pipes were used. Directories were discovered with ls only. After the first reading pass, the cited ranges were re-read to verify every quotation and line number. The only programs run were ls and python3 -I (to merge and validate this JSON).
meta.state_of_tree: The worktree has uncommitted changes (foundation.json, foundation.py, tail.py, surprise.py and others are untracked or modified), and it was still being edited while this pass ran. Line numbers describe the files as last read; the source_snapshot key records the size and modification time of each cited file at the end of the pass.
caveats: AGENTS.md says: 'Docs are not ground truth ... Authoritative sources: Rohan, then the code. When sources conflict, surface it.' Statements are therefore tagged by speaker and status, not ranked.

Many sources pre-date the October 2026 construction: June 2026 docs (NSM_GRAMMAR_MAPPING.md, LEXICON_REBUILD.md, ARCHITECTURE.md), the retired curation pipeline under gse/curation/, and Rohan's earlier papers. They are tagged DOC_JUNE2026, CODE_LEGACY or ROHAN_PAPER. They are included because they are existing statements; the repo's own docs mark several of those routes retired or historical.
docs/THEORY.md was deliberately not read: AGENTS.md calls it 'known-invalid'.

The NSM works themselves (Wierzbicka 1999 and others, filed under data/external/references/) were not read. What they say is known here only through the chart text (read in full) and through the agent-written docs/verification/lexicon-rebuild/closeout-2026-10-25/NSM_RESOLUTIONS.md and evidence/nsm_sources.json.

'nearest NSM prime named by a source' lists only primes a source actually names for the coordinate. The requester's examples (MORE, VERY, MANY/FEW/SOME/ALL, LIVE/DIE, CAN+NOT, BECAUSE+DO/HAPPEN) are prompts to look, not facts; where no source names a prime the field says 'none named' and any chart boxes are listed as context only.
Tests (tests/*) were not read, so statements about what tests pin are not made.

Papers-folder files (tag ROHAN_PAPER) are not treated as Rohan's rulings: GSE_V2.md and pronouns_numbers.md read as implementation plans, and sentence_architecture.md lines 84-117 as a pasted status report. They are quoted because they are existing statements; where they disagree with the founder record or the code, the contradictions section sets both sides out without a verdict.

The links between coordinates and contradiction ids are partly mechanical: each coordinate's contradiction_ids holds the ids cited by hand plus every id whose own coordinates list names that coordinate (added by merge.py; see meta.contradiction_id_links).
